H5: Unchanged BETA V1: five exact prior years of same calendar month, type-7 quantiles, strict dengue count>P75; no substitution. Future threshold references must be <=T.
history: Before 2011-06, only pinned BETA V1 counts/coverage for its 76 territories support current H5 and lags. No post-2024 rows enter calculations. Other territories retain unknown H5 until enough window history exists.
absence: D1 preserves symptom-onset chronology; D2/D3 zero notification counts in fixed calendar; no duplicate removal; 5663 unresolved in-window territorial records remain unassigned in Step 1 reconciliation.
climate: Consume pinned Step 2 UNION ALL declaratively, without executing data-local Python. Reuse aggregate_monthly_climate: sums for rain/runoff/evaporation/solar; means for temperature/dewpoint/soil/U/V; every variable requires all calendar days, else null. No imputation.
eligibility: Per horizon: complete nonclimate predictors, current non-excess, known exact-calendar onset, no record-review flags, T and T+h inside fixed window, target<2025. WITH_CLIMATE additionally requires all nine complete climate variables. NO_CLIMATE and WITH_CLIMATE are logical masks, not duplicate physical tables. Same BETA role boundaries and origin embargo remain mandatory; paired climate contrasts must intersect cohorts.
comparison: All common equivalent columns on shared keys for original 76 municipalities; exact counts/H5/states/lags/labels/coverage; report floating-point climate differences separately with strict numeric diagnostic tolerance 1e-10. Outcome-gated fields for post-window targets are intentionally unavailable and cannot admit training.
publication: Existing content-addressed, atomic, no-overwrite publication; single national CSV plus contract, dictionary, provenance, comparison and eligibility summaries. No training authorized.
limitations: Retrospective snapshots do not establish point-in-time operational availability.
Current DIVIPOLA does not certify historical boundary applicability.
Climate geometry equivalence and immutable upstream snapshots remain unverified.
Insular climate missingness must remain null; national pre-2011 history is unavailable outside the 76 reference territories.
